KRCE_AdrenalineBattery.name: Adrenaline Battery
KRCE_AdrenalineBattery.description: Clearing a combat room grants +15% movement speed for 8 seconds.

KRCE_EchoMagazine.name: Echo Magazine
KRCE_EchoMagazine.description: Every sixth standard gun volley fires a free extra volley. Special weapons and melee are excluded.

KRCE_EmergencyRelay.name: Emergency Relay
KRCE_EmergencyRelay.description: After surviving a hit at 25% health or less, take 50% less damage for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds.

KRCE_OverheatedRelay.name: Overheated Relay
KRCE_OverheatedRelay.description: +12% direct damage, but take 15% more damage. A cursed crowd favourite.

KRCE_LeadBoots.name: Lead Boots
KRCE_LeadBoots.description: Lose 8% of the speed-stat range and gain 4 defense points.

KRCE_StaticCoil.name: Static Coil
KRCE_StaticCoil.description: Each cleared combat room drains 5% of maximum armour. Health is not drained.
